EventManager's legacy branch (else when destination.credentialId is falsy) calls `createEvent(c, event)` without externalId, and CalendarManager passes credential.id; a destination with null credentialId never matches the find, so the event is created on 'primary' instead of the configured destination calendar (previously the code used `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.externalId` directly). judged_text: createEvent selects the calendar via find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId), which never matches destinations whose credentialId is null, so selectedCalendar falls back to 'primary'. Bookings from users whose DestinationCalendar rows have null credentialId (the legacy branch EventManager still explicitly supports at line 347) now create the event on the account's primary calendar instead of the configured destination calendar, and because EventManager's legacy branch calls createEvent(c, event) without externalId, the stored reference also has no externalCalendarId, so later updates/deletes cannot locate the event at all.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent` to choose `calendarId` via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and otherwise fall back to `"primary"`. In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the legacy path explicitly handles destinations with no `credentialId` (the `else` branch when `destination.credentialId` is falsy) by calling `createEvent(c, event)` without providing any destination externalId context. For legacy `DestinationCalendar` rows where `credentialId` is `null` but `externalId` is set, the `.find(...)` will not match and Google will insert into the account's primary calendar instead of the configured destination calendar. Additionally, because `createEvent(...)` now returns `externalId` only from the optional third argument and the legacy branch does not pass it, downstream code that now uses `result.externalId` (instead of `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId`) will store/propagate `undefined` for `externalCalendarId`.
